gloss.for: для (too small for = замалий для); for so long = так довго

clips.note: Monk compares two cards and two envelopes. This card is too small.
clips.noteUa: Монк порівнює дві листівки й два конверти. Ця листівка замала.
around: This card came with the poison bottle.

clips.line: way too small for the amount of necklaces that I had at the time.
clips.note: Emma had a little stand for her necklaces. It was way too small for all of them.
clips.noteUa: У Емми була маленька підставка для намиста. Вона була замала для всіх її намист.
around: Like, for so long I had this, like, little necklace stand or whatever, that was

clips.line: It’s not too big, it’s not too small, it’s just right.
clips.note: Monica describes the place for her new restaurant: not too big, not too small, just right.
clips.noteUa: Моніка описує приміщення для нового ресторану: не завелике, не замале, якраз.
around: It’s this cute little place on 10th Street.
